description: The spec's sensitive marks are a name match and get these fields backwards. EnvironmentSecret.value is the secret itself (spec example `mysql://user:pass@host:port`) and is plain, on both the read shape and the input the convert splits from it. ContainerEnvVar.value is plain too, and holds whatever the deployer sets on a container; GET .../applications/{applicationId} returns it. ApplicationCustomRuleSecretMapping.secret is marked sensitive only because of its name: the spec describes it as `Environment secret name` (example `amqp-host-environment-secret`), a reference a caller has to read back. Read from the sca v1beta spec, 2026-11-01. Nothing on the wire changes.
